tasks.title: Conductor sandbox drill
tasks.description: A harmless plan for testing Conductor end to end: routing by engine and by capability, a fallback, a file lock, a run with no change, a user gate and a lead gate. Every task changes a few lines of a toy Node project.

tasks.title: Add clamp() to src/math.js
tasks.description:
Goal: add `export function clamp(value, min, max)` to src/math.js, with a one-line doc comment like the others. It returns min when value < min, max when value > max, and value otherwise. It throws a RangeError when min > max.
Acceptance: test/math.test.js gains one test for clamp that covers a value below, inside and above the range, both edges, and the RangeError. Existing tests are unchanged.
Files: src/math.js and test/math.test.js only.
Test: node --test

tasks.title: Add titleCase() to src/strings.js
tasks.description:
Goal: add `export function titleCase(text)` to src/strings.js, with a one-line doc comment like slugify's. It upper-cases the first letter of each word and keeps the rest of the word as written, and collapses runs of spaces into one: 'hello  wide world' gives 'Hello Wide World', 'iOS app' gives 'IOS App', '' gives ''.
Acceptance: test/strings.test.js gains one test for titleCase with those three cases. The slugify test is unchanged.
Files: src/strings.js and test/strings.test.js only.
Test: node --test

tasks.title: Note phase 1 in CHANGELOG.md
tasks.description:
Goal: in CHANGELOG.md, under '## Unreleased', add two bullets after the existing one: '- `clamp(value, min, max)` in src/math.js.' and '- `titleCase(text)` in src/strings.js.'
Acceptance: CHANGELOG.md has three bullets under '## Unreleased'. Nothing else in the repo changes.
Files: CHANGELOG.md only.
Test: node --test

tasks.title: Sign off phase 1
tasks.description: For the person running the drill: check that the PRs of A1, A2 and A3 are merged, then approve this gate on the dashboard's Conductor page. Phase 2 waits for it.

tasks.title: Add formatBytes() to src/format.js
tasks.description:
Goal: in src/format.js, directly under the line '// B1: formatBytes() goes below this line.', add `export function formatBytes(n)` with a one-line doc comment. It formats a byte count with binary units and one decimal: 0 gives '0 B', 1023 gives '1023 B', 1024 gives '1.0 KB', 1536 gives '1.5 KB', 1048576 gives '1.0 MB'. Units: B, KB, MB, GB, TB. A negative number throws a RangeError. Leave the B2 marker and everything below it as it is.
Acceptance: a new file test/bytes.test.js tests those cases and the RangeError.
Files: src/format.js and test/bytes.test.js only.
Test: node --test

tasks.title: Add formatDuration() to src/format.js
tasks.description:
Goal: in src/format.js, directly under the line '// B2: formatDuration() goes below this line.', add `export function formatDuration(seconds)` with a one-line doc comment. It returns 'm:ss' under an hour and 'h:mm:ss' from an hour up, using the existing pad2(): 0 gives '0:00', 65 gives '1:05', 3600 gives '1:00:00', 3725 gives '1:02:05'. Fractions are dropped. A negative number throws a RangeError. Leave the B1 marker and everything above it as it is.
Acceptance: a new file test/duration.test.js tests those cases and the RangeError.
Files: src/format.js and test/duration.test.js only.
Test: node --test

tasks.title: Check the README usage examples
tasks.description:
Goal: run the code block of the 'Usage' section of README.md from the repo root by piping it into `node --input-type=module` (do not leave a file behind). Each console.log line ends with a comment giving the expected output. If an output differs, correct that comment in README.md. If every output matches, change nothing: a run with no change is the expected result.
Acceptance: every example's comment matches what node prints.
Files: README.md only.
Test: node --test

tasks.title: Lead sign-off: every PR merged
tasks.description: For the lead: check that the PRs of B1 and B2 are merged and that `node --test` passes on the default branch after a pull, then approve this gate with cortex_task_review.
